screens.name: model-view
steps: Open C:\MGLab\power-bi\ep01\src\ContosoSales.pbip (Auto date/time off: File > Options and settings > Options > Global > Data load). If it will not open: blank report > TMDL view > paste TMDLScripts\create-model.tmdl > Apply, then turn on Discourage implicit measures in Model explorer
Home > Refresh; if asked for privacy levels or credentials choose Organizational / Windows
Go to Model view; arrange Sales in the centre, Date on top, Customer left, Product right, Store at the bottom
Show the four solid one-to-many lines with single arrowheads and the dashed line Sales[Ship Date] to Date[Date]
Hover the dashed line so both columns highlight; hold for a few seconds
mask: account name and picture at the top right of Power BI Desktop (sign out first)
Windows user name in any file path (record from C:\MGLab)

screens.name: data-pane
steps: Switch to Report view and expand the Data pane fully
Expand Sales: only Order Number and the display folders Sales and Margin (no keys, no Unit Price)
Expand Product to show the Product Hierarchy (Category > Subcategory > Product)
Expand Date to show the Calendar hierarchy; hold
mask: account name and picture at the top right of Power BI Desktop (sign out first)
Windows user name in any file path (record from C:\MGLab)
